customer_name: Industrial Bank Co., Ltd. (兴业银行)
business_problem: Industrial Bank needed a more scalable service model that could handle standard banking tasks automatically, route complex disputes to humans, and keep financial services running even when customers and staff could not easily visit branches.
solution_summary: Industrial Bank and Baidu AI Cloud built a new generation of intelligent customer service around a whole-bank intelligent voice platform and a human-machine collaboration model. In the first phase, the joint team launched visual service handling, multi-turn dialogue management, and sentiment analysis so routine standard业务 could be completed by intelligent robots while disputed or complicated cases were transferred to human staff. The platform then improved speech recognition, speech synthesis, and natural-language processing to support more granular service segmentation and richer scenarios. During the pandemic, the service was adapted regionally so callers in cities such as Shanghai and Changchun heard special greeting and guidance flows, while elderly users received a 'just say it' voice experience with dedicated menus and fast access to human support when needed. Over time, the bank has treated the system as both a service channel and a source of customer data that can feed broader remote banking, refined management, and precision marketing strategies.

solution_components.name: Intelligent Voice Platform
solution_components.role: Provides the whole-bank voice infrastructure for automated service handling, guidance, and regionalized pandemic-era banking support.

solution_components.name: Intelligent Customer Service
solution_components.role: Combines visual service handling, multi-turn dialogue, sentiment analysis, and service stratification to automate standard banking tasks and route complex issues.

data_flow: Customer calls enter the intelligent voice platform, speech recognition and NLP classify the request, intelligent customer-service flows either complete the transaction or route complex cases to human agents, and accumulated interaction data feeds later service optimization, segmentation, and marketing uses.
business_outcome: Industrial Bank improved service continuity, automated a large set of routine banking tasks, and built a more personalized remote-service channel with strong measurable gains in usage and quality.
metrics: 80% of online business handled during the pandemic
architecture_clues: The first phase combined visual service handling, multi-turn dialogue management, and sentiment analysis in one service stack.
The bank applies stratified service strategies so different customer groups and business scenarios can receive differentiated support.
The platform doubles as both a service channel and a data-asset generator for operations and marketing.
